issues.quote: You score 1 point for each surrounding tiles, as well as the monastery tile.
issues.explanation: The phrase 'each surrounding tiles' is grammatically incorrect and ambiguous. It is unclear whether players score 1 point per surrounding tile or some other amount.
issues.suggested_rewrite: You score 1 point for each of the surrounding tiles, as well as 1 point for the monastery tile.

issues.quote: You score 1 point for each surrounding tiles, as well as the monastery tile.
issues.explanation: S93 is unclear but could imply varying points based on surrounding tiles, while S109 explicitly states a completed monastery scores exactly 9 points. These seem to contradict regarding how monastery scoring works.
issues.suggested_rewrite: A completed monastery scores 9 points (8 surrounding tiles × 1 point each, plus 1 point for the monastery tile itself).
